Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: partial.

Asset repair is real document state: a relink records the replacement digest, round-trips in document v4, survives bundling, and is undoable. The board notes correctly retain the source half: source checking must fail closed before preview and Save & run, and the real backend must verify bytes when reading. The current repair tests establish stored asset repair, not changed-at-the-same-path detection, run/design blocking, reopen behavior, or the missing-image UI state. Keep this ticket open for those source and presentation criteria.

Evidence:
- studio/core/src/test/scala/eyes4s/studio/core/assets/AssetRepairSuite.scala:31
- studio/core/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/core/backend/StudyBackend.scala:118

Remaining / next action: Add changed-source/reopen and missing-image behavior through the desktop flow, including fail-closed preview/run verification.

Disposition: Keep open.
